title: V1 evidence migration, claim by claim
description: The audit V1-S5-012-PR2 performed over every claim in the v1alpha1 claim and evidence register: for every claim that cited a record, the eight questions answered from the cited files, with verbatim quotes; the outcome of every record in the migrated v1alpha2 register, derived by comparing the two registers; a justification for every level that changed; every correction made to a claim's own prose, with the text before and after; and the one status that changed. The answers were drafted per claim area by independent readers under the method published in the migration report, and every quote was checked verbatim against the file it names before this record was written.
